answer_text:
Northwind CRM Revenue Cloud is a strong product, but growing teams often look elsewhere once per-seat costs climb or setup needs an admin. Good alternatives:

1. Pipewell - the forecasting specialist: scenario planning and deal-risk scoring out of the box.
2. Kestrel CRM - auto-logs emails and meetings to deals, so pipelines stay current.
3. Halcyon Sales - solid pipeline views with built-in calling; the reporting needs some setup.

Pick Pipewell for breadth, or Kestrel CRM if you want something your reps will adopt faster.
